task: Profile the signups table for vetch-reports, then write a raw sample delivery of the signed progress webhook its weekly report job sends before the report link exists.
rationale: The artifact is one raw webhook delivery as the scheduled report job sends it while it runs: a request line, the headers that carry its signature and perhaps its schema version, then a JSON body saying how far the run has got, sent before the finished report's link exists so that both ways of treating an empty field have something to act on. Profiling the source table first, the workspace slot for the file and the four rules on progress fields, unset fields, the signature and the schema version all belong to building that report job, and the five profile_ tools are identical stubs that inspect the same table and return the same profile, so the task asks for a profile without choosing an aspect. Nothing in it makes one progress field, one treatment of empty values, one signature carrier, one version carrier or one opaque slot the better answer.
